lines.text: Judah's sin is engraved with a diamond point on their hearts and on the horns of their altars.
Because of the sin of the high places, the LORD will enslave Judah to its enemies in a land they do not know.
The man who trusts in mankind will be like a cedar in the desert, dwelling in a salt land.
The man who trusts in the LORD is like a tree planted by the road, with leaves always green.
The LORD searches the heart to reward a man by his deeds, and the man who makes a fortune unjustly will be the fool.
